Can we scrape publicly available web data to train our generative AI model, and stay GDPR-compliant?
We're signing up a new hosting provider that will store EU customer data. Draft the key clauses our data processing agreement must contain.
Ransomware hit our systems last night and personal data of about 40,000 EU customers may have been exfiltrated. Walk me through our GDPR obligations step by step.
